info.title: ol
info.description: Open-source license checker for resolved dependencies and SBOMs.

commands.name: clear
commands.description: Clears cached evidence for the specified category.

options.name: --cache-dir
options.description: Root directory containing the managed cache categories. [Default: null]

commands.name: check
commands.description: Check a canonical JSON scan report against allowed SPDX licenses.

options.name: --report
options.description: Persisted canonical JSON scan report to evaluate. [Required]

options.name: --allow-licenses
options.description: Comma-separated SPDX License Identifiers. [Required]

options.name: --allow-dev-licenses
options.description: Comma-separated SPDX License Identifiers additionally allowed for development-only components. [Default: null]

options.name: --exclude-packages
options.description: Comma-separated package URL prefixes whose components are not evaluated. A prefix may stop at the ecosystem, as in pkg:github/. [Default: null]

options.name: --spdx-data
options.description: Directory containing licenses.json and exceptions.json. [Default: null]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Include persisted report diagnostics.

options.name: --baseline
options.description: Baseline file acknowledging already reviewed unresolved components. [Default: null]

options.name: --update-baseline
options.description: Rewrite the baseline file as a complete snapshot.

options.name: --sarif
options.description: Write violations as SARIF to this file for CI code scanning. [Default: null]

commands.name: diff
commands.description: Compare two persisted JSON scan reports and report license-relevant changes.

options.name: --previous
options.description: Previously persisted JSON scan report. [Required]

options.name: --current
options.description: Current JSON scan report. [Required]

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format. [Default: Text]

options.name: --input
options.description: Repeatable resolved dependency input files or directories. [Required]

options.name: --input-format
options.description: Input format: auto (default), cyclonedx, spdx, nuget-assets, npm-package-lock, pnpm-lock, yarn-classic-lock, yarn-berry-lock, cargo-metadata, go-module-graph, pip-inspect, composer-lock, bundler-lock, maven-dependency-tree, swift-package-resolved, or cocoapods-lock. [Default: @"auto"]

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: text, json, or markdown. [Default: Text]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Include verbose columns and input detection diagnostics.

options.name: --dependency
options.description: Dependency output filter: root,direct,transitive,unknown. [Default: null]

options.name: --group-by
options.description: Group output by fields: name,version,license,ecosystem,dependency,status. [Default: null]

options.name: --sort
options.description: Sort keys: ecosystem,name,version,license,dependency,status,purl. [Default: @"ecosystem,name,version"]

options.name: --sort-order
options.description: Sort order: asc or desc. [Default: Asc]

options.name: --spdx-data
options.description: Directory containing licenses.json and exceptions.json. [Default: null]

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress stderr summary.

options.name: --refresh
options.description: Ignore cached package metadata, source repository, and GitHub file entries and fetch them again.

options.name: --cache-dir
options.description: Root directory for isolated package-metadata, source-repository, and GitHub file caches. [Default: null]

options.name: --no-external-evidence
options.description: Use only license evidence declared in the input; package registries, source repositories, and their caches are never read.

options.name: --skip-evidence-packages
options.description: Comma-separated package URL prefixes whose external evidence is never collected. A prefix may stop at the ecosystem, as in pkg:github/. [Default: null]

options.name: --concurrency
options.description: Maximum concurrent package metadata and source repository lookups. [Default: 0]

options.name: --retry
options.description: Retry count for package registry and GitHub License API requests. [Default: 1]

commands.name: export-plugin
commands.description: Export a portable Agent Plugin package.

options.name: --output
options.description: Destination plugin directory. [Required]

options.name: --with-claude
options.description: Include a Claude Code plugin manifest adapter.

options.name: --force
options.description: Replace an existing destination directory.

commands.name: install
commands.description: Install the skill into the current workspace.

options.name: --target
options.description: Target agent: codex or claude. [Default: @"codex"]

options.name: --output
options.description: Override the destination skill directory. [Default: null]

options.name: --force
options.description: Replace an existing destination directory.

commands.name: update
commands.description: Download SPDX data into the user data directory.

commands.name: version
commands.description: Show the active SPDX data source.
